response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and AWS — aligning with core requirements — but his title and responsibilities suggest senior-level expertise, raising concerns about fit for an entry-level role, and his German language skill is only basic despite high on-site requirements.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven full-stack ownership from API to UI with real-world scalability
Active open-source contributions and deep architectural understanding
concerns: Title and experience suggest seniority beyond entry-level role expectations
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site presence requirement
Overabundance of diverse tech stack may indicate lack of focus on renewable energy domain
